verdict.rationale: ClickHouse exposes a documented OpenAPI/HTTP interface for queries and a CLI (clickhousectl) that can create/manage Cloud clusters, ClickPipes, Postgres services, and other Cloud-console-level resources, suggesting broad API/CLI parity with the UI. However there is no explicit statement or independent test confirming every UI capability (e.g., billing dashboards, monitoring views, backup export config) is fully mirrored via API. Missing for 10: explicit vendor claim of 1:1 API/UI feature parity, independent verification that all Cloud console actions are scriptable, and coverage of non-data-plane UI features (billing, org admin) via API.
